mapper.sql: campaign_id, name, type, status, segment_id, template_id, coupon_id, scheduled_at, trigger_type, started_at, ended_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign (name, type, status, segment_id, template_id, coupon_id, scheduled_at, trigger_type, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{status}, #{segmentId}, #{templateId}, #{couponId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{triggerType}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET name = #{name}, segment_id = #{segmentId}, template_id = #{templateId}, coupon_id = #{couponId}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, trigger_type = #{triggerType}, updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coupon WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM segment WHERE segment_id = #{segmentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET status = #{newStatus}, updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE campaign SET status = 'SCHEDULED', scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE campaign SET status = 'DRAFT', scheduled_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
mapper.select: UPDATE campaign SET start_claimed_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED') AND updated_at = #{readAt} AND (start_claimed_at IS NULL OR start_claimed_at < now() - interval '10 minutes') RETURNING start_claimed_at
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET start_claimed_at = NULL WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND start_claimed_at = #{claimedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND scheduled_at <= now()

SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign c WHERE c.type = 'ONE_TIME' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.started_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM send_log sl WHERE sl.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND sl.status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING') )
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET status = 'COMPLETED', ended_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
